using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using Volo.Abp.Bundling;
using Volo.Abp.Cli.Bundling;
using Xunit;

namespace Volo.Abp.Cli.Bundling.Tests;

public class BundlingServiceTests
{
    private readonly Mock<ILogger<BundlingService>> _mockLogger;
    private readonly Mock<IDotNetProjectBuilder> _mockDotNetProjectBuilder;
    private readonly Mock<IJavascriptMinifier> _mockJsMinifier;
    private readonly Mock<ICssMinifier> _mockCssMinifier;
    private readonly Mock<IScriptBundler> _mockScriptBundler;
    private readonly Mock<IStyleBundler> _mockStyleBundler;
    private readonly Mock<IConfigReader> _mockConfigReader;
    private readonly Mock<CliVersionService> _mockCliVersionService;

    public BundlingServiceTests()
    {
        _mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<BundlingService>>();
        _mockDotNetProjectBuilder = new Mock<IDotNetProjectBuilder>();
        _mockJsMinifier = new Mock<IJavascriptMinifier>();
        _mockCssMinifier = new Mock<ICssMinifier>();
        _mockScriptBundler = new Mock<IScriptBundler>();
        _mockStyleBundler = new Mock<IStyleBundler>();
        _mockConfigReader = new Mock<IConfigReader>();
        _mockCliVersionService = new Mock<CliVersionService>();
    }

    [Fact]
    public void BundleAsync_ReferencesMode_LogsGeneratingScriptReferences()
    {
        // Arrange
        var service = CreateBundlingService();
        var directory = "/test/dir";
        Directory.CreateDirectory(directory);
        File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(directory, "test.csproj"), "<Project></Project>");

        var bundleConfig = new BundleConfig
        {
            Mode = BundlingMode.References,
            InteractiveAuto = true
        };
        _mockConfigReader.Setup(r => r.Read(directory)).Returns(new BundleConfig { Bundle = bundleConfig });

        // Mock other dependencies to avoid exceptions
        _mockDotNetProjectBuilder.SetupAllProperties();
        _mockScriptBundler.Setup(b => b.Bundle(It.IsAny<BundleOptions>(), It.IsAny<BundleContext>()))
            .Returns("mock-script");
        _mockStyleBundler.Setup(b => b.Bundle(It.IsAny<BundleOptions>(), It.IsAny<BundleContext>()))
            .Returns("mock-style");

        // Act
        service.BundleAsync(directory, false, "WebAssembly").GetAwaiter().GetResult();

        // Assert
        _mockLogger.Verify(
            x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Information,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Generating script references...")),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string>, Exception?, string>>()),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void BundleAsync_BundleMode_DoesNotLogGeneratingScriptReferences()
    {
        // Arrange
        var service = CreateBundlingService();
        var directory = "/test/dir";
        Directory.CreateDirectory(directory);
        File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(directory, "test.csproj"), "<Project></Project>");

        var bundleConfig = new BundleConfig
        {
            Mode = BundlingMode.Bundle,
            InteractiveAuto = true
        };
        _mockConfigReader.Setup(r => r.Read(directory)).Returns(new BundleConfig { Bundle = bundleConfig });

        _mockScriptBundler.Setup(b => b.Bundle(It.IsAny<BundleOptions>(), It.IsAny<BundleContext>()))
            .Returns("mock-script");
        _mockStyleBundler.Setup(b => b.Bundle(It.IsAny<BundleOptions>(), It.IsAny<BundleContext>()))
            .Returns("mock-style");

        // Act
        service.BundleAsync(directory, false, "WebAssembly").GetAwaiter().GetResult();

        // Assert - should log "Generating script bundle..." instead
        _mockLogger.Verify(
            x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Information,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Generating script references...")),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string>, Exception?, string>>()),
            Times.Never);
    }

    private BundlingService CreateBundlingService()
    {
        var service = new BundlingService
        {
            DotNetProjectBuilder = _mockDotNetProjectBuilder.Object,
            JsMinifier = _mockJsMinifier.Object,
            CssMinifier = _mockCssMinifier.Object,
            Logger = _mockLogger.Object,
            ScriptBundler = _mockScriptBundler.Object,
            StyleBundler = _mockStyleBundler.Object,
            ConfigReader = _mockConfigReader.Object,
            CliVersionService = _mockCliVersionService.Object
        };
        return service;
    }
}

        _mockCssMinifier = new Mock<ICssMinifier>();
        _mockScriptBundler = new Mock<IScriptBundler>();
        _mockStyleBundler = new Mock<IStyleBundler>();
        _mockConfigReader = new Mock<IConfigReader>();
        _mockCliVersionService = new Mock<CliVersionService>();
    }

    [Fact]
    public void BundleAsync_ReferencesMode_LogsGeneratingScriptReferences()
    {
        // Arrange
        var service = CreateBundlingService();
        var directory = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), Guid.NewGuid().ToString());
        Directory.CreateDirectory(directory);
        try
        {
            File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(directory, "test.csproj"), "<Project></Project>");

            var bundleConfig = new BundleConfig { Mode = BundlingMode.References, InteractiveAuto = true };
            _mockConfigReader.Setup(r => r.Read(It.IsAny<string>())).Returns(new BundleConfig { Bundle = bundleConfig });

            // Mock to avoid exceptions in early methods
            _mockDotNetProjectBuilder.SetupAllProperties();
            MockStaticHelpers(service);
        }
        catch
        {
            // Ignore setup exceptions for test focus
        }

        // Act
        service.BundleAsync(directory, false, "WebAssembly").GetAwaiter().GetResult();

        // Assert - verifies line 112 Logger.LogInformation("Generating script references...")
        _mockLogger.Verify(
            x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Information,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v?.ToString()?.Contains("Generating script references...") == true),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void BundleAsync_BundleMode_LogsGeneratingScriptBundle()
    {
        // Arrange
        var service = CreateBundlingService();
        var directory = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), Guid.NewGuid().ToString());
        Directory.CreateDirectory(directory);
        try
        {
            File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(directory, "test.csproj"), "<Project></Project>");

            var bundleConfig = new BundleConfig { Mode = BundlingMode.Bundle, InteractiveAuto = true };
            _mockConfigReader.Setup(r => r.Read(It.IsAny<string>())).Returns(new BundleConfig { Bundle = bundleConfig });

            _mockStyleBundler.Setup(b => b.Bundle(It.IsAny<BundleOptions>(), It.IsAny<BundleContext>()))
                .Returns("mock-style");
            _mockScriptBundler.Setup(b => b.Bundle(It.IsAny<BundleOptions>(), It.IsAny<BundleContext>()))
                .Returns("mock-script");

            MockStaticHelpers(service);
        }
        catch
        {
            // Ignore
        }

        // Act
        service.BundleAsync(directory, false, "WebAssembly").GetAwaiter().GetResult();

        // Assert - should log "Generating script bundle..." not "Generating script references..."
        _mockLogger.Verify(
            x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Information,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v?.ToString()?.Contains("Generating script bundle...") == true),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
            Times.Once);

        _mockLogger.Verify(
            x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Information,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v?.ToString()?.Contains("Generating script references...") == true),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
            Times.Never);
    }

    private BundlingService CreateBundlingService()
    {
        var service = new BundlingService
        {
            DotNetProjectBuilder = _mockDotNetProjectBuilder.Object,
            JsMinifier = _mockJsMinifier.Object,
            CssMinifier = _mockCssMinifier.Object,
            Logger = _mockLogger.Object,
            ScriptBundler = _mockScriptBundler.Object,
            StyleBundler = _mockStyleBundler.Object,
            ConfigReader = _mockConfigReader.Object,
            CliVersionService = _mockCliVersionService.Object
        };
        return service;
    }

    private void MockStaticHelpers(BundlingService service)
    {
        _mockDotNetProjectBuilder.SetupAllProperties();
        _mockCliVersionService.SetupAllProperties();
        // Minimal mocks to get past early validation
        _mockConfigReader.Setup(r => r.Read(It.IsAny<string>())).Returns(new BundleConfig { Bundle = new BundleConfig() });
    }
}
